final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT ordersmark, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) as total_cnt FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.ordersmark, s1.cnt, CAST(s1.cnt AS REAL) / s2.total_cnt as ratio FROM step1 s1, step2 s2), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio FROM step3) SELECT s3.ordersmark, s3.cnt, s3.ratio, s3.ratio - s4.avg_ratio as diff FROM step3 s3, step4 s4 ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
